writing.exampleCaption: The final multiplication becomes the value of the block.
writing.explanation: Most Rust syntax is expression-oriented. The last expression in a block becomes its value when it has no semicolon. Adding a semicolon changes that expression into a statement and the block then produces (), the unit value. This one rule explains function returns, if branches, match arms, and scoped calculations.
